requirements.anchor: Build a tiny dependency-free Node.js slugifier with automated tests and usage documentation.
requirements.title: Complete dependency-free slugifier deliverables
criteria: slugify.mjs exports string-only slugify implementing NFKD, mark removal, lowercase, ASCII separator collapse and trimming, including empty results and no CLI side effects.
cli.mjs joins arguments with spaces and prints one newline; no arguments emits stderr usage and exits 1.
slugify.test.mjs uses Node test/assert for roadmap examples, empty input, repeated separators, type errors and spawned CLI success/failure.
README.md documents API, examples, CLI and npm test; exactly four requested files are added.

evidence.description: Inspected standalone exported function and normalization pipeline.
Inspected argument branch, console output and exitCode.
Inspected 12 built-in runner tests with subprocess assertions and Unicode cases.
Read README and coherent manifest: only README, API, CLI and tests added alongside supplied package and roadmap.

reviews.reasoning: Independently read original roadmap and all four delivered files. Consolidated slugifier-roadmap revision 1 accounts for every roadmap clause: string-only pure API with exact normalization steps and empty output, argument-joining CLI/newline/error usage, built-in test/assert examples and subprocess cases, documentation and exact four added files. Coherent manifest contains only supplied roadmap/package plus required additions. Tests additionally cover compatibility normalization and import purity; shared operation a3-npm-test-complete passed on this exact manifest.

Independent inspection confirms typeof guard throws TypeError, NFKD followed by Unicode M removal then lowercase/ASCII separator collapse/edge trim; module has only export and no CLI execution. CLI slices argv, joins spaces, console.log adds one newline; absent args prints usage to stderr and sets status 1. Tests use node:test/assert with all requested examples, empties, separator runs, nonstrings and spawned CLI outputs/status. README accurately documents API/CLI/npm test. Evidence hashes match inspected exact manifest; A3 shared npm test operation succeeded with 12 passing tests and unchanged source.
